 Jalen Smith (finger) is probable for Wednesday’s game against the Knicks. 
 Yet to miss a game this season, Smith has filled in for the injured Nic Claxton as the Bulls’ starting center. However, with Claxton close to making his Bulls debut, Smith’s role will likely change soon.

 CHI 
 Center 
 #9 
 Nic Claxton (hamstring) is questionable for Wednesday’s game against the Knicks. 
 For the first time this season, the Bulls have listed Claxton as questionable ahead of a game. If he can play on Wednesday, Zach Collins could see his playing time decrease after playing 10 minutes in Monday’s loss to the 76ers. The question is whether the Bulls would start Claxton immediately; that would push Jalen Smith to the bench. 
 Jalen Smith 
 CHI 
 Forward-Center 
 #25 
 Jalen Smith finished with 13 points (6-of-10 FGs), seven rebounds, four assists and one three-pointers against the 76ers on Monday. 
 Smith played through a finger injury and remained in the starting role that he has held all season. This was a decent performance for him during what has been a strong start to the year. However, Nic Claxton (hamstring) is getting closer to making his debut for Chicago. When Claxton is healthy and up to speed, he’ll likely be this team’s starting center. Smith holds value as a temporary starter, but when Claxton returns, Smith’s value will take a big hit.

 ESPN’s Shams Charania reports that the Thunder acquired Nique Clifford from the Kings for two second-round picks. 
 The Thunder need depth after being hit hard by injuries, while Clifford gets a fresh start after falling out of the Kings’ rotation. As a rookie, the 24th overall pick in the 2025 draft averaged 8.6 points, 3.8 rebounds and 2.4 assists in 25.1 minutes per game last season. Clifford averaged just over six minutes per game in eight appearances this season. Clifford may have a few more opportunities in Oklahoma City, a franchise that has developed young talent well over the years.
